title: Fix Aggregator Introduction Panel Cutouts and Step Order
description: The Entwerfen mit Bestand Aggregator introduction is still adhoc: (1) the Katalog step must cut out the uncollapsed panel (not only the tab chip), (2) the add-component step's info box must sit to the right of the panel instead of on top of it, (3) adding a component must come before the move-utility step. Fix at the introduction mechanism root (panelTab cutout = visible panel) and rewrite the brand tour order/placement accordingly.
summary: Drag-and-drop add step now unveils all world-3d windows as interactive drop targets. IntroductionStepDefinition gained optional cutouts (validated like the primary anchor); UIIntroduction punches multi-rect veil holes from step.cutouts plus shell-supplied additionalCutoutSelectors; the shell auto-includes every world-3d window kind for panelFirstDraggable. Brand/puzzle add-object steps declare puzzle3d-main cutout. Runtime verified on Aggregator: first catalogue row pulses and puzzle3d-main stays unveiled (veilAtProbe/veilAtDrag false).
